prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.

Q: That's fine, we'll note the claimant identity is on file. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was making a left turn across the opposing lanes when the other vehicle hit the rear portion of my car.

Q: Were you turning at a green light or a arrow?

A: I had a green light, but there was no protected left arrow. I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic before I started moving.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. It was approaching from behind and to the side, and I was focused on the oncoming cars. I felt the impact before I could react.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt pain in my right shoulder almost immediately. I was able to get out of the car on my own, but the shoulder was sore and I had trouble lifting my arm.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and was referred for imaging. I have a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic provider next week.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your account?

A: Only that I believe I was turning lawfully and I want to make sure my medical bills are covered. Thank you for your help.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
